description: This file defines functions to construct various Telegram-specific UI components, such as pagination buttons, provider selection, model selection, and browsing options, for a chat-based interface. It serves as a utility module bridging backend data with frontend Telegram button interfaces.

methods.name: export function buildCommandsPaginationKeyboard( buildCommandsPaginationKeyboard
methods.description: Constructs an array of button rows for paginating through commands, including previous, current page indicator, and next buttons.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramCommandsListChannelData(params: { buildTelegramCommandsListChannelData
methods.description: Builds Telegram channel data with pagination buttons for command lists; returns null if only one page.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelsProviderChannelData(params: { buildTelegramModelsProviderChannelData
methods.description: Creates Telegram channel data with provider selection buttons; returns null if no providers.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelsListChannelData(params: { buildTelegramModelsListChannelData
methods.description: Builds Telegram channel data with model selection buttons for a specific provider, supporting pagination.

methods.name: export function buildTelegramModelBrowseChannelData(): ReplyPayload["channelData"] { buildTelegramModelBrowseChannelData
methods.description: Returns Telegram channel data with browse providers button.
